name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Interschool Choreographic Dance Competition
benefit:
##### ***Monetary Benefits***
**Prize Money for Standard 1st-4th Category**

- 1st Prize: ₹7,000/- plus memento and certificate.
- 2nd Prize: ₹5,000/- plus memento and certificate.
- 3rd Prize: ₹3,000/- plus memento and certificate.
- Best Choreographer: ₹3,000/- plus memento and certificate.

**Prize Money for Standard 5th-10th Category**

- 1st Prize: ₹10,000/- plus memento and certificate.
- 2n
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be an educational institution. - The applicant must form a dance group consisting of not less than 6 dancers. - The applicant must form a dance group consisting of not more than 10 dancers. - The applicant must choose to participate in either Standard 1st-4th category or Standard 5th-10th category. - The applicant must perform on only one patriotic song in Konkani language. - The applicant must not use fusion of different songs in their performance. - The applicant must provide a recorded copy of the song on Compact Disc along with the application form. ***Compliance Requirements*** - The applicant must read and understand all rules and regulations of the organization. - The applicant must abide by all competition rules and regulations. - The applicant must accept that the decision of the panel of judges will be final and binding. - The applicant must accept that Tiatr Academy of Goa reserves the right to make any changes in the rules.
